settings.title: BLACKLYTE × MAJOR
settings.text:
In celebration of the world’s most prestigious Major—we’ve created a special-edition gaming chair built for those who play to win.

Designed for maximum performance and long-session comfort, this chair combines tournament-level ergonomics with elite adjustability. Whether you're grinding solo queues, leading your team to victory, or streaming to fans around the world, this is the seat that supports every moment of your rise.

settings.title: Exclusive Blacklyte Custom Embroidery
settings.description: Each Austin Major Edition chair features a meticulously embroidered emblem, crafted with 798,760 precision stitches that capture the spirit of Major competition, and reflects our pursuit of quality, performance, and design excellence.

settings.title: Adaptive Ultra-Soft Velvet Headrest
settings.description: Wrapped in ultra-soft velvet-touch fabric, the magnetic headrest offers breathable comfort and ergonomic neck support. Effortlessly adjustable, it conforms to your posture for all-day ease.

settings.title: Trendy & Impressive Style
settings.description: Featuring a deep navy base with striking red overlays, this Blacklyte x Austin Major edition delivers a powerful visual statement. The sharp color contrast reflects the spirit of competition: bold, focused, and unapologetically distinctive.

settings.title: Introducing the Austin Major Edition Gaming Chair
settings.description: Blacklyte is proud to collaborate with the legendary Austin Major to present this exclusive edition gaming chair, crafted to deliver unmatched comfort and commanding style for competitive gamers worldwide. Every detail captures the spirit of championship play, symbolizing the precision, intensity, and fearless energy seen on the Major stage.

settings.title: ULTRA-SOFT MEMORY FOAM
settings.description: Why settle for hard, uncomfortable foam when our ultra-soft memory foam cradles you in cloud-like comfort, while delivering the perfect support designed to keep you supported and focused for years to come.

settings.title: MAGNETIC NECK PILLOW
settings.description: Effortlessly adjustable, our magnetic neck pillow stays securely in place while delivering ergonomic support exactly where you need it, keeping your neck and shoulders relaxed at all times.

settings.title: 4-WAY DYNAMIC ARMREST
settings.description: Engineered to follow your natural posture, our armrests move smoothly in all directions to reduce muscle and joint strain, keeping you aligned, supported, and comfortable.

settings.title: INTEGRATED 4-WAY DYNAMIC LUMBAR SUPPORT
settings.description:
The lumbar support is the heart of a good gaming chair and ours is exceptional. Height and depth
adjustments ensures a perfect fit for your spine, delivering theultimate comfort and support you need.

settings.title: Athena Pro Austin Major Edition Spotlights
No Limits, Full Season
settings.description: “There is no royal road to win, but we never walk backwards.” -Top Esports
